format: html
Author: Greta Tillery
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent_bachelors_plus = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_plus),
    y = percent_bachelors_plus
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "CA",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca_counties <- age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate)

ggplot(age_ca_counties, aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(
    data = age_ca_counties |>
      slice_max(population, n = 5) |>
      mutate(
        label_y = median_age + case_when(
          NAME == "Los Angeles County, California" ~ 2.3,
          NAME == "San Diego County, California" ~ 1.3,
          NAME == "Orange County, California" ~ 2.4,
          NAME == "Riverside County, California" ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -1
        ),
        label_hjust = if_else(NAME == "Los Angeles County, California", 1, 0)
      ),
    aes(
      y = label_y,
      label = stringr::str_remove(NAME, " County, California"),
      hjust = label_hjust
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Population and Median Age by County",
    subtitle = "California, 2020",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 ACS 5-Year Estimates"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
